page.notes: The running head is "De Episcopatu"; the printed "§.XIV" at the top right is the division number, so it is not part of the running head. "Do-ctores" appears in a heavier face that may be black letter; it is transcribed as roman. Some letters in "eam tuiti sunt" are smudged by specks on the scan, but the words read clearly. The long s has been written as a plain s throughout. The ct ligature in "hactenus" and "doctrina" is written as ct.
